title: Discovery.
bodyText: A civil action in the nature of a bill for discovery may be brought according to the usages and principles of courts of equity, unless the matter is governed by the rules of court.
bodyHtml: §624-25  Discovery.  A civil action in the nature of a bill for discovery may be brought according to the usages and principles of courts of equity, unless the matter is governed by the rules of court. [L 1972, c 143, §1(c)]
